How the room works

STEP ONE

Read the three bios above and pick whoever actually fits your question: research and essays go to Sonya, activity-building goes to Xiyuan, local recognition goes to Rahem.

STEP TWO

Email them directly. No form and no gatekeeper, just describe what you're stuck on.

STEP THREE

They write back when they can. This is real students with real schedules, not a support desk.

Still deciding who to ask?

Write to any of them. If it's really someone else's territory, they'll say so and point you over.
